validity.researcher_notes: Note this row is still Status=proposed (P3162 out-of-scope 'Status = N/A' rule does not apply here; this is a genuine active proposed project, not the excluded row). ONEOK's Saguaro Connector Pipeline, LLC filed a Presidential Permit application with FERC for a border-crossing facility in Hudspeth County, TX: 'approximately 1,000-foot, 48-inch-diameter natural gas pipeline...that would cross the United States and Mexico International Boundary below the Rio Grande', originating at the Waha Hub and ultimately designed for 2.8 Bcf/d capacity, feeding a pipeline being developed on the Mexican side to carry gas to the west coast for liquefaction/export (ogj.com, 'ONEOK files for Saguaro Connector natural gas pipeline border crossing'; FERC approved the project in 2024). Independently, the Big Bend Sentinel's local reporting (bigbendsentinel.com, 'Saguaro Connector Pipeline, to carry natural gas to border for export, under federal review') confirms the same Hudspeth County border-crossing description and federal review process from a separate, non-ONEOK origin. The flagged endpoint (30.940, -105.497) lands in Mexico near this same border-crossing corridor -- consistent with the drawn line reaching a real interconnect point rather than a boundary artifact (a true precision artifact would be meters, not the multi-km span implied by the 3.0 km Mexico landfall). This is a sheet-classification question, not a geometry fix, so no coordinates are proposed.
